title: Friend dying on the moon

tellings.quote: There was a conversation I had with someone who I trust who got very emotional and described a friend of his dying on the moon.

plain: Someone is said to have broken down while describing a friend of his who died on the moon, which would point to a secret space programme beyond anything the public knows of. The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels he heard this from a person he trusts, whom he does not name, and he gives no date or details of how it happened.
